## About

I am a Research Statistician, Data Scientist, and Monitoring and
Evaluation specialist with experience in survey research, biostatistics,
data management, statistical analysis, stakeholder analysis, proposal
development, and scientific research and writing.

My work spans multidisciplinary research projects in public health,
epidemiology, survey research, monitoring and evaluation, and programme
assessment.

[More about me →](about.qmd)

## Research & Evidence

I am interested in applying rigorous statistical methods, data science,
and emerging technologies to research and evidence generation. I value
analytical rigour, reproducibility, clear communication, and the
responsible use of data to support better decisions.
